run_fast_rcnn_inference: run fast_rcnn_inference to filter detections by score threshold and apply NMS across a batch of images
test_FastRCNNOutputLayers: test FastRCNNOutputLayers forward pass to compute classification scores and box regression deltas from per-region features
review_FastRCNNOutputLayers_losses: review FastRCNNOutputLayers.losses to compute classification and box regression losses from predictions and ground-truth proposals
build_FastRCNNOutputLayers: build FastRCNNOutputLayers with configurable box2box transform, num_classes, loss weights, and federated loss options
refactor_FastRCNNOutputLayers_inference: refactor FastRCNNOutputLayers.inference to predict boxes and probabilities then run batched NMS inference per image
